answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by tying identity to a costly, verifiable resource: each agent must lock a stake at a graph vertex representing its real owner, and every transaction carries a signed heartbeat pulse proving continuous control of that stake. A fake identity has no history to defend, so a dawn audit that re-checks stake ownership and liveness lets peers drop cheap clones instantly. Creating thousands of sybils then costs thousands of stakes, while honest agents pay once.
